text:
Implemented additional graph traversal, bundle and pack handling, object parsing, client credential lookup, and HTTP helpers. Changes are committed.

The full suite now runs: **218 passed, 1,233 failed, 10 errors, 35 skipped, 1 xfailed**. The library remains incomplete; I have not established that the remaining failures are unfixable.

**The library is not complete, and the test suite does not pass.**

The full-suite run stopped during `conftest.py` import with 0 tests passing; that result was committed as `tests: 0 passed`. I made and committed partial utility implementations afterward, but a targeted test run still stops during import because `sphinx.util.parsing._fresh_title_style_context` is missing.

I cannot enumerate the remaining test failures because collection has not succeeded. The repository also contains hundreds of unimplemented functions and methods, so the partial changes are not sufficient to complete the requested restoration.

I added several missing helpers and advanced the import further. It now stops in `repo/networkx/algorithms/approximation/steinertree.py`, where `_kou_steiner_tree` and `_mehlhorn_steiner_tree` are referenced but absent.

The work remains incomplete and unverified; I cannot yet enumerate the test failures. I did not run the whole suite or create a commit.

Continued implementation and fixed the syntax errors found by compilation. `tests/test_version.py` now passes all **6 tests**, and `tests/test_aliases.py` collects successfully.

The full suite still cannot run: its latest attempt stopped during collection with **0 passed**, and I committed that result as `tests: 0 passed`. Subsequent changes are uncommitted. The first alias test now fails because `ModelMetaclass._collect_bases_data` is missing; substantial model construction and validation code remains unimplemented.

The library implementation is **not complete**.

I implemented mailmap parsing and lookup in `repo/dulwich/mailmap.py`; its two tests pass. The full suite was unable to run: collection stopped with 40 errors, including a Python 3.10 syntax error in `dulwich/client.py` and missing property methods in `dulwich/objects.py`. Hundreds of function bodies remain unimplemented, so I cannot identify every eventual test failure from that run.

Commits:
- `319597f` — `tests: 0 passed`
- `a57f102` — mailmap implementation

Still incomplete. I implemented additional HTTP utilities, options, logging, signed values, and restored test-method execution in `AsyncTestCase`. The changes are committed.

Verification:
- HTTP utilities: **47 passed**
- Options and logging: **39 passed**
- Signed values: **10 passed**
- Whole-suite collection: **833 tests collected**

I have not run the complete suite since collection was fixed. Core async, networking, and web implementations remain incomplete, so the requested outcome has not been reached.

NetworkX now imports. The whole-suite run stopped during collection with 14 errors, so no tests passed. The errors include missing functions and graph constructors that return `None`.

I committed the partial work in `repo/` as `6986db1` (`tests: 0 passed`). The library remains incomplete.

Continued implementing repository, index, object-store, and patch functionality.

The latest full-suite run still reports **435 passed, 1,005 failed, and 10 errors**. The work is committed in `repo/` as `b5f58f5` (`tests: 435 passed`); details are in `scratch/full6.log`.

The requested work remains incomplete. I have not established that the remaining failures are unfixable.

Further work completed:

- The focused pragma, utility, and caching tests now pass: **34 passed, 2 skipped**.
- A full-suite run reached collection but stopped with **22 collection errors**, primarily from missing definitions in the skeleton. As required, I committed the work present at that run as `tests: 0 passed`.
- Subsequent utility and caching fixes are uncommitted.

The library is still incomplete. A separate message-test run had 34 failures, and the full suite cannot yet enumerate its runtime failures.

The implementation is **not complete**. HTTP server, web, routing, and template functionality remain substantially stubbed, and I have not established that their remaining failures are unfixable.

The latest interrupted full-suite run did not produce a test summary. Focused runs passed 67 coroutine tests and 91 HTTP request/error, lock, and queue tests; five coroutine web-integration tests still fail.

One environment-specific failure is understood: the TCP source-port test expects an unprivileged user to be unable to bind port 1, but this environment permits it.

Continued implementing formatted text, completion, and style functionality. The latest full-suite result is **60 passed, 74 failed, 16 errors, and 1 xfailed**, committed as `072c24f` (`tests: 60 passed`).

The library remains incomplete. The reduction in errors includes buffer tests now reaching unimplemented buffer behavior; it does not mean those tests pass. I have not established that the remaining failures cannot be fixed.

Implementation remains incomplete. The latest whole-suite run stopped at collection with **0 passed and 5 errors**:

- Nested dataclass schema generation is unsupported.
- `pydantic.deprecated.parse.load_file` is missing.
- Pipeline construction returns `None`.
- Generic model type-variable traversal is unimplemented.
- `pydantic.v1.typing.is_literal_type` is missing.

These are implementation gaps, not established unfixable failures. Many other skeleton methods remain unfinished.

Targeted verification passed **81 tests**, with one skipped, across `tests/test_aliases.py`, `tests/test_typing.py`, and `tests/test_version.py`. The work was committed as `e21fdcd` (`tests: 0 passed`).

The work remains incomplete. I added alias, configuration, decorator, and utility implementations. A targeted run now passes **150 tests**.

The latest full-suite run stopped during collection with **0 passed** and was committed as `tests: 0 passed`. A subsequent collection-only run found **21 collection errors**, including missing functions in typing, network, and decorator modules. Model construction and validation also remain incomplete. The latest `type_adapter.py` change is uncommitted.

The implementation is incomplete. The whole suite could not collect: after fixing the initial syntax errors and two missing definitions, importing `jinja2` still fails because `repo/src/jinja2/compiler.py` references the missing `_make_binop` function.

I implemented node traversal helpers and the built-in template tests, but substantial parser, compiler, runtime, and other functionality remains missing. Because collection does not complete, I cannot enumerate the individual test failures or claim they are unfixable. The last whole-suite run reported **0 passed**; it occurred before the latest import fixes.

Implemented packet-line protocol handling and locked file writes.

- `tests/test_protocol.py`: **42 passed**
- `tests/test_file.py`: **10 passed, 1 skipped**
- Changes committed as `d68895b` and `cd254b5`.

The requested library implementation remains incomplete; the whole test suite has not yet been brought past collection.

Continued implementing core graph behavior, including directed and multigraph operations, conversions, views, and path, cycle, and star helpers.

Verification: **179 passed** across `test_graph.py`, `test_digraph.py`, and `test_misc.py`. Multigraph tests still have failures, and many library stubs remain. The whole suite has not been run, so its passing count is unknown.

Continued and committed utility implementations in `28b30b0`.

Verified in isolated runs: 11 matching tests, 5 catalog/date tests, and the `NodeMatcher` test pass. The normal test run still cannot collect: it now stops on a missing `code_role` in `sphinx/roles.py`. The full library remains incomplete.

I made partial changes in `repo/networkx/utils/decorators.py`, `repo/networkx/utils/backends.py`, and the directed graph classes to get past the initial import errors.

Import now stops because `_single_source_dijkstra_path_basic` is missing entirely from `networkx/algorithms/centrality/betweenness.py`, rather than present with a `pass` body. The implementation remains incomplete. I did not run the whole test suite or make a commit.

I continued resolving collection errors and committed the changes as `28c37c2` (`tests: 0 passed`).

The suite remains incomplete: it stops during collection with 8 errors. The current blocker is the missing `load_basic_bindings` function in `src/prompt_toolkit/key_binding/bindings/basic.py`. Many other functions remain unimplemented, so the individual test failures cannot yet be assessed.

Implemented more of the message-definition and message-ID stores, plus message formatting and checker message construction.

Verification: **67 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected** across the focused message, caching, utility, and pragma tests. The deselected test depends on the still-incomplete lint runner. The full suite remains blocked by collection errors, so its remaining failures are not yet known.

Changes since the last `tests: 0 passed` commit are uncommitted.

The implementation is **not complete**. The latest full-suite run finished with **121 passed, 29 failed, and 1 xfailed**. It used a scratch timeout plugin: six tests exceeded its two-second limit, so those failures would otherwise hang.

All remaining failures are in `repo/tests/test_cli.py`, primarily around incomplete Emacs and Vi bindings, selection, macros, history/search, and multiline editing. They are not established as unfixable.

The latest work is committed as `21ebee3` (`tests: 121 passed`). Full output is in `scratch/pytest14.txt`.

I continued the implementation. The library now imports, and the targeted tests for utilities, ID tracking, and nodes pass: **26 passed**.

The whole suite now collects, but its run was killed after reaching 50%, before pytest produced a summary. Many tests failed before it was killed. Template rendering remains blocked by unimplemented parser, compiler, and environment methods, including `Environment.from_string`.

The requested work is still incomplete; I cannot yet enumerate every remaining failure or explain why each could not be fixed.

Implemented the library substantially; the latest full suite reports **846 passed, 5 failed**. The work is committed in `repo/`, most recently as `tests: 846 passed`.

The remaining failures are not yet fixed. All five stem from the interpreter-backed compilation approach:

- Custom `CodeGenerator` overrides do not affect rendering.
- Generated source does not contain the expected deterministic filter and import bindings.
- Generated source does not expose the expected internationalization call or autoescape-folded output.

Fixing these requires implementing compatible Python code generation rather than the current interpreter wrapper.

I could not complete the implementation. The library currently cannot be imported: `py_random_state` returns `None`, causing a `TypeError` during initialization. There are also over a thousand `pass` placeholders across the package.

No files were changed, and I did not run the whole test suite. I therefore cannot characterize each remaining failure or claim that the suite passes.

Continued restoring the import path and fixed three Python syntax errors. The focused pragma test still cannot run: test setup now reaches `PyLinter`, but `_make_linter_options()` returns `None`, preventing initialization.

The library remains incomplete, and the full suite’s failures cannot yet be enumerated because collection is blocked. The changes made since the `tests: 0 passed` commit are uncommitted.

The full suite now completes: **61 passed, 790 failed**. The run was committed as `tests: 61 passed`.

I added lexer, filter, loop, bytecode-cache, and environment helpers. The remaining failures are largely blocked by the still-unimplemented template parser, compiler, and rendering pipeline. I cannot yet account for every individual failure or claim that each is unfixable.

Continued with partial implementation:

- Added reflog parsing, formatting and entry removal.
- Added several object helpers and fixed a Python 3.10 syntax error in `dulwich/client.py`.
- Verified `tests/test_reflog.py` and `tests/test_mailmap.py`: **7 passed**.
- Committed as `584d3c6`.

The library remains incomplete. Test collection still reports 39 errors, and many function bodies remain unimplemented. I cannot claim the remaining failures are unfixable; I have not completed the requested work.

The suite is not yet passing: **99 passed, 46 failed, 5 errors, 1 xfailed**.

This continuation implemented dimension helpers, basic control and container support, button rendering, and multiline prompt splitting. The changes were committed as `fa61c5c` (`tests: 99 passed`).

Remaining failures involve substantial unimplemented areas, including application and input handling, key processing, layout rendering, formatted output, and regular-language grammars. They have not been shown to be unfixable.

Implemented LRU caches and LFS object storage in commit `13b2d25`.

Verification: **40 tests passed** across `tests/test_lru_cache.py`, `tests/test_lfs.py`, `tests/test_reflog.py`, and `tests/test_mailmap.py`.

The full library is still incomplete; collection continues to report 39 errors.

**The test suite does not pass.** The full-suite run stopped during conftest loading with 0 tests passed: `pylint.utils.utils` is missing `_check_csv`, so pytest could not collect tests. The remaining test failures therefore cannot yet be enumerated.

I added `parse_pragma` in `repo/pylint/utils/pragma_parser.py` and verified it with isolated smoke tests, but did not complete the library. The repository has hundreds of stubbed functions and also appears to be missing some definitions entirely; restoring the implementation remains substantial unfinished work.

The required `tests: 0 passed` commit was made after the full-suite run. The subsequent pragma change is uncommitted.

Continued implementation and committed the changes.

The normal full-suite run reached collection but stopped with **60 collection errors and 0 tests passed**; it was committed as `tests: 0 passed` (`949e520`). Subsequent targeted runs passed 16 console, matching, and reST tests, plus 3 selected reST tests. Those later changes are in `c8915b0`.

The full suite remains incomplete: collection errors include missing functions in display, autodoc, image, node, and other utilities.

Implemented and committed async loop, coroutine, lock, queue, socket-binding, and DNS support.

Targeted tests pass: **53 IOLoop, 40 lock, 41 queue, and 10 netutil tests**. The full suite has not been rerun; HTTP client/server and other functionality remain incomplete.

**Still incomplete.** NetworkX now imports, and all 31 tests in `networkx/utils/tests/test_misc.py` pass. I also added missing helpers needed for imports and verified basic isomorphism match-helper behavior.

The broader suite remains unverified and the graph classes and many algorithms are still stubs. I cannot account for each remaining failure without completing those implementations. No whole-suite run or commit was made.

The library is still incomplete. I added implementations in `escape.py`, `util.py`, and parts of the concurrency and asyncio support, and committed the changes.

- `escape_test.py`: **11 passed**
- `util_test.py`: **20 passed, 1 skipped**
- Whole-suite collection: **435 tests collected, 7 collection errors**. The remaining code includes many unimplemented or missing methods, so the suite is not yet runnable in full.

I have not established that the remaining failures are unfixable.

Continued with partial utility implementations and committed them in `5066180`.

Verification: five selected console and matcher tests pass with `--noconftest`. The normal test run remains blocked during import by the missing `sphinx.util.i18n.format_date`; the library and full suite are still incomplete.

The implementation is still incomplete.

This continuation added HTTP utilities, locale handling, event-loop and coroutine support, network utilities, and TCP server scaffolding. It also fixed the test harness so asynchronous tests are no longer silently omitted or passed without executing; that exposed hundreds of additional tests.

The latest whole-suite run was interrupted after 25 seconds: **97 passed, 83 failed, 43 skipped, and 2 errors** at that point. It was committed as `4c6afd0` (`tests: 97 passed`). The output is in `scratch/suite6.log`.

I cannot state that the remaining failures are unfixable. Major portions of the HTTP and stream implementations remain unfinished.

The implementation is incomplete. I added partial cache, filter, and document implementations, but the full suite still reports **0 passed and 21 collection errors**. All collection errors currently stem from the missing `in_paste_mode` export in `src/prompt_toolkit/filters/app.py`; additional missing code remains behind that error.

The partial work is committed in `repo/` as `615d7ba` (`tests: 0 passed`). I cannot establish the causes of individual test failures until collection succeeds.

Continued implementation and committed the work as `9f26a4e` (`tests: 27 passed`).

The full suite now reports **27 passed, 98 failed, 25 errors, and 1 xfailed**. Document and history tests pass, but substantial parts of the library remain unimplemented. I have not established that the remaining failures cannot be fixed.

The library is **not complete**, and the test suite does not pass.

I implemented parts of `pydantic/_migration.py`, `pydantic/version.py`, and `pydantic/alias_generators.py`. The full-suite run stopped during conftest import with **0 passed**; I committed that result as `tests: 0 passed`. A subsequent targeted run was blocked by an `IndentationError` in `pydantic/_internal/_typing_extra.py`. Compilation also found syntax errors in five other files.

I cannot identify each remaining test failure because the suite cannot collect yet, and hundreds of function bodies remain unimplemented. The changes made after the required commit remain uncommitted.

The implementation is incomplete. I implemented parts of `tornado/escape.py` and `tornado/util.py` and committed them.

The latest whole-suite run stopped during collection with **29 errors and 0 tests passed**. Many modules still have removed bodies; `tornado/concurrent.py` also has an `IndentationError` that blocks imports. A targeted escape test run passed 10 tests and failed one.

I cannot claim the remaining failures are unfixable; they have not yet been resolved or individually investigated.
